preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in numbers)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input list must be integers.
The input list must not be empty.

postconditions.expression: len(str(return_value)) >= len(str(x)) for all x in numbers
postconditions.description: The returned number must have the maximum number of digits among all numbers in the input list.
If multiple numbers have the same maximum digit count, the first occurrence in the input list is returned.
